title: 5 Videos Every Window Film Company Should Post (Shot on Your Phone)
description:
Your best marketing is already on your phone. Here are 5 videos every window film company should post, and exactly how to shoot each one.

0:00 Why video sells window film
0:09 1. Before and after
0:23 2. Install time-lapse
0:36 3. Client testimonial
0:49 4. The owner explains
1:19 5. Temperature test
1:46 Want us to edit them for you?

In this video:
- Before and after: same spot, same angle, shot before and after the install
- Time-lapse: prop the phone up and record the whole job
- Testimonial: ask on install day, by the finished glass, or show your best Google reviews
- Owner on camera: one reason the film matters, in plain English
- Temperature test: an infrared thermometer showed the floor behind tinted glass 38 degrees cooler than in direct sun

Footage courtesy of MD Window Films, a Los Angeles window film installer: https://www.mdwindowfilms.com
